quotations.old_english: Sýn gecyrred underbæc and gescamian, ða ðe wyllaþ me yfelu
quotations.latin: avertantur retrorsum et erubescant, qui vŏlunt mihi măla

definitions.meaning: To shame, cause or bring shame to

source_text: ge-scamian; p. ode; pp. od. I. v. intrans. To be ashamed, to blush; er&u-short;besc&e-short;re :-- Sýn gecyrred underbæc and gescamian, ða ðe wyllaþ me yfelu avertantur retrorsum et er&u-short;bescant, qui v&o-short;lunt mihi m&a-short;la, Ps. Spl. 69, 3. II. v. trans. impers. To shame, cause or bring shame to; p&u-short;d&e-long;re :-- Sceal gescamian ða unrihtwísan it shall shame the wicked; er&u-short;bescant impii, Ps. Th. 30, 20. Gescamige hí, let it shame them; er&u-short;bescant, Ps. Spl. 82, 16. v. ge-sceamian.
